title: Privacy and cookies
description: Cookie preferences, Google Analytics and YouTube on Expedition Creativity.
heading:
Privacy.
Your choice.
lead: You choose whether to allow analytics and external videos.

sections.title: Essential storage
sections.body: We only remember your privacy choice locally in this browser. This essential preference contains no visitor ID and is not sent to a tracking service.

sections.title: Google Analytics
sections.body: Google Analytics is loaded only when you allow analytics. Reject all prevents this website from loading analytics code or setting new analytics cookies.

sections.title: YouTube
sections.body: Cover images are served by this website. The YouTube player and its scripts load only after separate permission for YouTube videos and when you start a video. We use the privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie.com player; this does not mean YouTube processes no data during playback. You can also go directly to YouTube, where YouTube’s own choices and terms apply.

sections.title: Change your preference
sections.body:
Use the permanent Cookie preferences button to reject all, choose individual categories or accept all. Withdrawing permission stops the player, removes analytics cookies accessible on our own domain and reloads the page to stop previously loaded tracking code.

We cannot remove existing cookies or storage belonging to other domains, such as youtube.com, from our website. You can remove those using your browser settings.

Questions? Get in touch.

source: Adapted to the consent behaviour of the new site; based on cookie-policy.html
